bestsellers: The Last of Us Part II
curiosities: Its eight-core AMD Jaguar processor is from the same family as the Xbox One's.
A Share button on the controller recorded and streamed play from the first day.
Remote Play streamed its games to a PS Vita, and later to phones and PCs.
With over 117 million sold, it is one of Sony's best-selling consoles.
It launched in North America on 15 November 2013.
It has 8 GB of fast GDDR5 memory shared by processor and graphics.
Its DualShock 4 has a touch pad and a light bar.
Its system software is built on FreeBSD.
A Slim model and the PS4 Pro, for 4K, came in 2016.
PlayStation VR, a headset for it, came in 2016.
The PlayStation 5 plays almost all of its games.
